correctness.rationale: Explicit Picard-class construction gives 27 lines and 45 tritangents; exact enumeration gives 120 repeated Steiner supports, all 51840 Weyl elements, minimum-cycle frequencies (22752,6480,5760,6480,10368), and 12960 rational-tritangent/no-pair elements. A 1+5 Frobenius-stable blowup of six general-position points exists for every q >= 4 and has 24 five-cycles on pairs. Banwait–Fité–Loughran Theorem 1.9 supplies the asymptotic class frequency. Code path verify_steiner_frobenius.py and saved verification_output.json contain executable certificate.

They do not state the evaluated shortest-orbit distribution on 120 Steiner pairs, rational-tritangent/no-pair quarter-density, or explicit uniform geometric sharpness; these require the additional 120-label action calculation and a new geometric construction. value.rationale: The arithmetic descent degree of a canonical 120-point finite marking is determined for every cubic surface, with sharp realizability for all q >= 4 and a surprising positive asymptotic frequency 1/4 of rational tritangents without rational Steiner pairs. This goes beyond the underlying geometric count and the 27-line Frobenius table.
